title: Earn a contributor role by sharing a schematic
summary: Members who submit at least one approved schematic of a TheySix farm or build can receive the contributor role.
author: Mihai, Manager

body.text: Check the wanted list to find a missing schematic. Read the submission rules, then upload the file in the submissions channel. Staff verify each file before publishing it in the farm archive.
